ranked.summary: Recent work audits fungal and viral genome collections for metadata and quality, while a published study links fungal lifestyle to genome content.

ranked.summary: Mechanistic and structure-based free-energy models are now validated against single-molecule, force, and simulation data for Cas9 and RNA systems.

ranked.summary: T2T-level assemblies and long-read sequencing now resolve centromeres, telomeres and rDNA across individuals, providing benchmarks for variation studies.

ranked.summary: Three December 2025 preprints apply learned components to chemical reaction networks and single-cell trajectory dynamics, including multi-step planning.
